problem_type: Renderer-side failures leave no evidence in the persisted log, so exported diagnostics bundles show that something failed but never why
symptom: A Windows user's diagnostics bundle (manifest.json + logs/nomi-crash.log + logs/nomi-2026-09-24.log + model-catalog.json) contained only main-process lines; the user saw 'studio.projectSaveFailed' but the bundle held no line about the save failure or its cause (WorkspaceManifestLockBusyError, fixed separately in PR #862).
direct_cause: NomiStudioApp onSaveError (and the window-close / hard-reload save paths in useProjectWindowLifecycle) only called console.error(...) and then showed a localized toast; renderer console output is not persisted in packaged builds (devDiagnostics forwards it to stderr only in dev).
class_root: The renderer had no persisted failure-evidence sink. 54 console.error/warn sites plus every uncaught error / unhandled rejection wrote only to DevTools; the single renderer-to-main log channel (nomi:log:renderer-crash) served the two crash boundaries only and took free text that the 200-char value cap truncated. In addition, the shared redaction cut Windows/POSIX paths at the first space, so the default 'Nomi Projects' root leaked project names into any logged error message.
affected_population: Every packaged-build user on every platform whose failure is raised or observed in the renderer (project save/create/restore/delete/rename, asset import/delete, timeline, production, canvas, agent panel, crash boundaries, uncaught renderer errors)
Every user whose logged error messages contain a path with a space (the default project root is '~/Documents/Nomi Projects')
entry_points: Project save failure: autosave (NomiStudioApp onSaveError), rename save, window-close save, hard-reload save
Project create / demo create / restore (hydrate) / delete / rename / release failures in NomiStudioApp and project helpers
Asset library, browser asset, timeline, export, production, canvas, director, 3D viewer, memory, agent-panel failure handlers (54 console.error/warn sites in total)
Root and chunk error boundaries (previously the raw nomi:log:renderer-crash channel)
Uncaught renderer errors and unhandled promise rejections (previously no handler at all)

The other 33 migrated call sites are one-line consumer changes (console.error/warn -> owner); they are listed in doors and same_class_entry_points, not in scope_paths, because the invariant is owned by the logging boundary rather than by those modules

external_sources.purpose: Prior art: electron-log sends renderer logs to the main process over a single IPC channel and the main process owns the file writer; we copy that shape but accept only structured scalar payloads because our logs ship in user-exported bundles.

Prior art: errorHandler.startCatching is installed in both processes to catch uncaught errors and unhandled rejections; installRendererErrorCapture is our renderer-side equivalent feeding the same channel.

invariants: Every renderer failure report reaches the persisted main-process log through exactly one renderer owner (src/desktop/rendererLog.ts) and one main-process entry (electron/logging/rendererLog.ts).
No src/** production file calls console.error or console.warn except the owner (eslint no-console, hard zero).
The renderer never redacts; the main process applies the one shared redaction (redact.ts) to every renderer line, and malformed payloads are rejected with a logged reason.
An absolute path inside quotes, a drive-letter path, or a path under a user-content POSIX root is redacted as a whole even when its segments contain spaces.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The renderer owner is the only caller of bridge.log.report and eslint no-console makes it the only renderer failure outlet; electron/logging/rendererLog.ts validates, rate-limits and writes through the shared redaction. The end-to-end test drives the owner into the real log file.

door_reduction.why_not: Counted with the same door-map on the log write/read path before (logRendererCrash, registerRendererCrashIpc, logCrash, redactLogValue, listLogFilesForBundle = 16) and after (owner API + wire + recorder + logCrash/formatLogFields/redactLogValue + readers). The count rises on purpose: the 36 renderer failure sites that are new write doors previously wrote nowhere persistent, which is the defect. They all converge on one owner (src/desktop/rendererLog.ts); the raw wire has one renderer writer (forwardToMainLog, down from two window casts) and one main registration. The two listLogFilesForBundle readers (diagnostics zip, one-click feedback tail) and the existing main-process logCrash / redactLogValue callers are unchanged consumers of the same redacted file.

generality_proof: The fix is not per call site: (1) every explicit renderer failure report must go through logRendererError/Warn/Crash because eslint no-console makes any other console.error/warn in src/** a lint error; (2) failures nobody catches reach the same owner through installRendererErrorCapture (window error + unhandledrejection); (3) the main process accepts renderer lines only through registerRendererLogIpc, which validates shape, rate-limits, and writes through the same logger/redact code as main-process lines. A new failure path added anywhere in the renderer therefore either uses the owner or is caught globally; there is no third route to the file.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Sole renderer caller of bridge.log.report: flattens errors (name/message/code/stack, one cause level) and scalar fields into the RendererLogEntry wire shape; never throws.
Routes uncaught renderer errors and unhandled promise rejections to the same owner.
Main-process entry: closed-shape validation (reject + log reason), per-event and total rate limits, level mapping onto logWarn/logError/logCrash with the shared redaction.
Single redaction owner for both processes; now removes quoted, drive-letter and user-root paths as a whole even with spaces in segments.
Hard-zero static gate: console.error/warn are forbidden in src/** production code outside the owner.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Reported case; now logRendererError('project-save-failed', error, { trigger: 'autosave' }). The create/restore/hydrate/delete/rename/release handlers in the same file were migrated the same way (12 sites).
Window-close and hard-reload save failures now log project-save-failed with trigger window-close / hard-reload; useProjectWindowLifecycle.test.ts asserts the bridge receives them.
Moved off the raw logRendererCrash bridge call onto logRendererCrash('root-boundary', ...), which keeps the crash file and adds a component-name summary instead of a truncated free-text blob.
Four console.error sites migrated; same shape as the save path (user sees a toast, cause went only to DevTools).
No global handler existed (rg 'unhandledrejection' src returned nothing); installRendererErrorCapture is now installed at renderer start.
Informational timing lines, not failure evidence; console.log/info/debug stay allowed by the lint rule.

recurrence.reason: Any new renderer failure handler written in the existing style (console.error + toast) reproduces the gap for a different feature; the save path was just the one a user happened to hit.
same_class_scan: rg -n "console\.(error|warn)" src --glob '!*.test.*' --glob '!**/__tests__/**' -> 54 sites in 33 files, all migrated
rg -n "unhandledrejection|window.onerror|addEventListener\('error'" src -> no global renderer handler existed
rg -n "logRendererCrash|renderer-crash" src electron -> 2 raw bridge callers + 1 main registration, replaced by one channel
redactLogValue probe on 'C:\Users\alice\Documents\Nomi Projects\<project>\...' and '/Users/alice/Documents/Nomi Projects/<project>/...' -> '<path> Projects\<project>...' before the fix

prevention.invariant: console.error and console.warn are forbidden in src/** production code except src/desktop/rendererLog.ts, so every renderer failure report goes through the owner that persists it.
prevention.failure_mode: pnpm run lint:ci fails with no-console on any new console.error/warn in src/**; the main process rejects malformed renderer payloads and logs renderer-log-rejected with the reason.
prevention.strategy: Close the class at the earliest layer the editor already shows (eslint), with no baseline because all 54 existing sites were migrated in the same change; uncaught failures are covered by the global capture on the same owner.

legacy_paths.rationale: registerRendererCrashIpc, the nomi:log:renderer-crash channel, the preload logRendererCrash method, both window-cast callers and the stale baseline identity are deleted in the same change; crashes now travel the one nomi:log:renderer channel at level crash. The two identical reloadRendererWindow copies in ErrorBoundary/chunkBoundary (each casting window around the typed bridge) are merged into src/desktop/bridge.ts reloadRendererWindow in the same change (structure review docs/audit/2026-09-24-src-desktop-ui-structure-review.md).

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency is added or changed; electron-log is cited as prior art only, not adopted (the existing logger/redact owner stays).

migration: No stored data changes. Old log files keep their format; renderer lines simply start appearing under scope 'renderer'. The channel rename is internal (preload and main ship together in one build).
residual_risks: Unquoted POSIX paths with spaces outside the listed user-content roots (/Users, /home, /Volumes, /private, /tmp, /var, /Applications, /opt, /mnt, /media, /root, /srv, /data) are still cut at the first space.
Error messages are free text by nature: a renderer error whose message embeds prompt text is only bounded by the 200-char value cap, the same policy the main-process log already accepts.
Renderer code that swallows an error silently (catch without logging) is not caught by the lint rule; it produces neither console nor log evidence.
